question: What is the nature of the supreme heart-mark described at the right end?
premises: At the right end there is a heart-mark regarded as supreme.
That mark is identified with the heart.
It contains within itself all created beings in fullness.
inference: The supreme heart-mark is not empty but inwardly contains the fullness of all created beings.
plain_english: And that heart-mark at the right end, regarded as the supreme heart, is also fully filled with all created beings taken within it.
